'''Cyanoberries''' were blue-colored berries that could be found on the swamp [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. This berry was a favorite food of the [[Leaf-tail/Legends|leaf-tail]].<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">"[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]"</ref>
